findings.finding: The primary protocol explicitly requests Q/SOC width/centre comparisons. fit_prefix reports Q_log_SD_ratio and Q/SOC centre offsets, and forecast voltage width ratios, but no endpoint SOC width comparison. The full selected covariance roots are retained, so a readout-only supplement can fulfill this obligation without changing fits.
findings.location: specifications/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001/README.md Matched probes and fits; experiments/hysteresis_mixed_completion_001/run.py fit_prefix same_anchor and fit_comparison
findings.required_disposition: Add a separately source/result-bound endpoint SOC-width supplement from frozen selected fits with full correlated covariance and direct/compressed endpoint Jacobians. Distinguish same-anchor approximation width from fit-to-fit width, preserve unresolved reference/candidate statuses and unsupported transports, and independently review the supplement. Preserve original runs, summary and review.
findings.effect_on_existing_claims: No defect found in existing Q/forecast calculations or displayed arithmetic. Revision concerns completeness of the registered diagnostic rather than invalidation of recorded results.
findings.author_disposition: Parent acknowledged and will produce a separate readout-only supplement followed by fresh-context review; no optimizer or representation changes.

accepted_assessments.truth_and_prior: Public mean/root and domain center derive from frozen public calibration. Hidden plant is confined to StimulusStream observation regeneration; truth return values are discarded. Exact and Compressed objectives each include the same original prior once. No raw-prefix and compressed-factor posterior are jointly counted.
accepted_assessments.chronology_and_domain: Single original stream per load; prefix growth retains response state and ordered actual intervals. All requested observation hashes equal frozen baseline hashes. Direct objective invokes R2_H2 feature-domain gate before direct evaluation; compressed fields share physical amplitudes, charge-extrema path and log-shape box. Native compressed chart-transport failures are preserved separately.
accepted_assessments.covariance_and_forecasts: solve returns origin-chart square root L chol(P)^-T, retaining all 16-variable cross terms. Current runner evaluates endpoint J times that root and future voltage J times endpoint root. Relative precision uses Cholesky congruence in common prior-whitened coordinates; no diagonal replacement or posterior duplication. Independent full-matrix covariance contractions and composite finite differences agree.
accepted_assessments.stopping_and_failures: Both fixed public starts use the unchanged 60-round solve. A converged candidate is preferred over lower-cost unresolved attempts; absent convergence, an unresolved selected attempt and all attempts remain recorded. All comparison/forecast claims require converged direct and candidate fits. Primary 51/54 converged and three unresolved fits, follow-up 26/27 converged and one unresolved are preserved. Numerical stop means cost-scaled GN roundoff or gradient threshold, not physical identifiability, global optimum or coverage.
accepted_assessments.source_and_result_integrity: All pilot/full/follow-up registered Python/native source identities verified. Primary runner hash matches archived run_r1.py; rc001 hash matches current runner. Case, factor snapshot, protocol, baseline registration/result and binary identities match. Native build source snapshots match current unchanged native sources.
accepted_assessments.analysis_and_inference: Analyzer exactly regenerates primary and RC follow-up compact sections. Probe counts, one-hour Q/forecast table, original-arm repeat differences and uncertainty quotations match raw evidence. RC follow-up is labeled outcome-informed and preserves original arms/failures. Nonpromotion and explicit local/finite/coverage/resource limits are justified.
accepted_assessments.resources: Packed factor arithmetic and lower numeric subtotals agree with class receipts; actual host arrays/scratch and excluded overhead are distinct. RC5 factors already exceed 10240 B; no complete target-memory or timing claim.

  assert abs(rms-row['RMS_difference_mV'])<1e-8
